audio.port: Port of DerpfaceJr/cat-town@42a7ab15 public/audio.js class Music (town track). Same material: BPM 64, BEATS_PER_CHORD 8 (7.5 s per chord), PADS I [48,52,55,59] for 0-7.5 s then vi [45,48,52,55] for 7.5-15 s with ~0.9 s release on the changing note, MELODY C-major pentatonic, no melody on beats 0 and 4 of a chord, a fixed stepwise walk written to the app's rules (7 notes, 5 rests of 12 slots ~42%), velocities 0.12-0.16, notes decaying over ~0.4 s. Nature layer: two bursts of 3 short rising sine chirps (base->base*1.3 over 0.09 s, peak 0.035), as in the app. Oscillator types of the app's pads/melody were not read; pads use sine plus a quiet 2nd partial so they carry on phone speakers. The melody walk is hand-written to the rules, not output of the app's createRng. loudnorm -16 LUFS so it is audible on a phone; fade in 0.6 s, fade out 13.5-15 s.

caption:
Founding a town of AI cats 🐾

A new town opens: the Mayor flies in, says hello, asks what the town should do, then shows you around.

Live capture of the Cat Town app's own intro, recorded frame by frame on a controlled clock. The recorder sends no inputs; the camera moves are the app's built-in cinematic. Parts of the intro are sped up or slowed to fit 15 s, and a few still moments get a slow zoom in the edit. The music is the app's own generated music, rebuilt in code for this edit. Made with AI and code.
